question: Gaddam Padmaja Reddy was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for her contributions to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaddam Padmaja Reddy **

 
 
• Gaddam Padmaja Reddy, a **well-known Kuchipudi dancer**, received the** Padma Shri award in 2022** for her **tireless efforts to advance the dance style**.
 
• **Former President Ram Nath Kovind** presented the Padma Shri to **Padmaja Reddy**.
 
• She is from **Pamarru, a village located about 15 kilometres away from Kuchipudi**.
 
• For nearly **50 years**, she has been performing **Kuchipudi**.
 
• She is renowned** for bringing to life on stage the illustrious past and beauty of the Kakatiya empire**.
 
• The** 51-year-old Hyderabadi dancer **has performed in more than **3000 concerts across 100 nations**.
 
• She was also influenced by the **book Nritta Ratnavali**, which describes **classical and traditional dance**.
 
• At the age of **five, she started dancing**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She **performed and directed part 1 of Kakatiyam in 2017**. The **second part** of it was conducted in **2021**.
 
• Together with approximately **100 other dancers**, she gave a **stunning Kuchipudi performance that earned her a lot of praise and admiration**.
 
• Over the course of her **40-year dance career, she has won numerous honours and rewards**.
 
• Th**e Sangeeta Nataka Akademi Award**, the **highest honour awarded by the Indian government to working artists**, was one of her largest honours. 
 
• She was the f**irst person from Telangana to ever get this honour**, which was given to her by **former President Pranab Mukherjee in 2016**.
